# Danish Civil Registration

This folder groups foundational administrative identifiers and clinical reporting frameworks utilized in Danish healthcare registries, particularly the Acute Surgery Database. It documents the central role of the civil registration number (CPR-nummer) in patient matching and dataset exclusions, alongside the Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocol that drives specific postoperative quality indicators. Additionally, it references the official reporting guidelines for the National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret), which standardize how clinical data and indicators are submitted to national authorities.

## Pages

- [[cpr-nummer|CPR-nummer]] — Details the use of the Danish civil registration number for patient identification and its frequent role in database exclusion criteria, such as invalid, deleted, or inactive numbers.
- [[eras|ERAS]] — Outlines the Enhanced Recovery After Surgery protocol, specifically its requirement for first-day postoperative mobilization and its influence on clinical quality indicators.
- [[indberetningsvejledning-til-landspatientregisteret|Indberetningsvejledning til Landspatientregisteret]] — References the official reporting guidelines for the National Patient Register, which govern data submission and indicator sourcing for clinical databases.
